verdict.rationale: Founder Law handles O-1A petitions (docs-3, docs-7) and offers pre-filing assessment. It has a case-assessment intake (docs-22) and a 90-minute strategy session with pre-session case review and an immigration roadmap (docs-8). It also says it maps realistic pathways and gives you a plan (docs-23). None of the evidence describes a structured evaluation of extraordinary-ability evidence against the specific USCIS O-1A criteria, or a documented qualification report. Missing for 10: an explicit O-1A criteria-by-criteria evaluation methodology, a documented written qualification assessment deliverable, and independent or hands-on corroboration.
